name: ponytail-vps
description: Ponytail fork: lazy senior dev mode whose reuse rung searches the whole VPS (all projects, skills, plugins) and copies what already exists before writing anything new.

ledger.title: Task board
ledger.description: After every turn, write this task's row (cost, turns, agent time, tokens, reuse, tests) to ~/.config/ponytail/band/<project>.csv for the board.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional: an https address that gets this task's row as JSON after every turn (a team board, n8n, a sheet script). Empty: nothing leaves this machine.

webhookToken.title: Webhook token
webhookToken.description: Optional: sent to the webhook as a Bearer token. Kept in the system keychain, never in a settings file or a repo.

sendNames.title: Send task names
sendNames.description: Send each task's name (its name in the Claude Code sidebar, or its first prompt) to the webhook. Off: the board shows the task without a name.
